cells: **Apache-2.0 — re-verified 2026-09-26** from the clone's `LICENSE`. Installed with `SKIP_MOTION_CORRECTION_IN_SETUP=1` (the repo's own documented escape hatch — the native `MotionCorrection` C++ extension's CMake build hardcodes x86 SIMD flags, `-msse4.1`/`-mavx`, and fails to compile on arm64; skipping it drops optional foot-skate post-processing, not generation). Build-time tool only.

Official CUDA-first generation CLI (`kimodo_gen` / `kimodo/scripts/generate.py`); confirmed to expose a real `Root2DConstraintSet` (root x/z trajectory + heading constraints, `kimodo/constraints.py`) and native `--bvh` export — materially more capable than `kimodo-mlx`
Not consumed by any shipped asset; installed and run for API/timing verification only

**Tool only.** More capable than kimodo-mlx (constraints + native BVH) but CPU-only on this machine (no CUDA; MPS crashes on a float64 buffer in `Kimodo.__init__`'s `.to(device)` — not patched further). Keep as the reference for constraint semantics; kimodo-mlx remains the faster local path for unconstrained text-prompt generation.
